messages:
rachel: hey team, first-day hiccup — im setting up an M2 MBP at home. Kandji shows Enrolled but the device is "Setup Complete" with no supervised profiles and I can't accept the kernel/network extension for our captive wifi. sudo fails (\"rachel is not in the sudoers file\"). also my SSH key didn't land and FileVault shows Off. anyone available for quick temp admin? :wave:

it-miguel: welcome rachel! can you paste the serial and run `fdesetup status` and `profiles status -type enrollment`? we generally give a 60m temp admin for these flows. please avoid reboot until we finish the check-ins.

rachel: serial C02YQW123456, `fdesetup status` -> "FileVault is Off." `profiles status -type enrollment` -> "No enrolled profiles." Screenshot of Kandji attached (shows agent checkin but no supervision).

mdm-zoe: thanks — looks like this device missed the supervised assignment in ABM due to a mis-tag. i'll reassign supervision and push the local admin script. granting 60 minutes now. enroller bot queued the supervision job.

eng-ops-bot: Job queued: assign_supervision -> device=C02YQW123456 (job=88211)

eng-ops-bot: Job completed: assign_supervision -> success (supervision=true)

mdm-bot: Deployment started: push_local_admin_88212 -> device=C02YQW123456
mdm-bot: Deployment completed: push_local_admin_88212 -> success (user added to /etc/sudoers.d/temp-admins)

rachel: i can sudo now, tried `sudo /usr/sbin/softwareupdate --install --all` to trigger the kext consent and got the Security & Privacy prompt. clicked Allow and the wifi network extension installed.

mdm-zoe: good. pushing FileVault enable + escrow and adding your SSH pubkey to the authorized_keys. if you prefer, paste your pubkey here and i'll add it to the profile record.

rachel: pubkey: ssh-ed25519 AAAAC3NzaC1lZDI1NTE5AAAAIBlahBlahExampleKey rachel@mbp

mdm-bot: Deployment started: push_fv_enable_88213 -> device=C02YQW123456
mdm-bot: Deployment completed: push_fv_enable_88213 -> success (FileVault enabled, key escrowed)
mdm-bot: Deployment started: push_ssh_profile_88214 -> device=C02YQW123456
mdm-bot: Deployment completed: push_ssh_profile_88214 -> success (authorized_keys updated)

rachel: SSH works, wifi/wireless driver good, and homebrew installs. leaving a note that the Supervision tag didn't apply automatically. thanks for the fast help! :tada:

it-miguel: leaving the 60m window active. when you're done reply here and we'll revoke temp admin. filing follow-up to audit device tagging rules so new hires don't hit this.

rachel: cleaned up test packages, all set — please revoke the temp admin. thanks again! :raised_hands:

mdm-bot: Temporary admin revoked: rachel -> removed from /etc/sudoers.d/temp-admins. closing job 88212.
